claims.quote: Submitting an existing identifier must show “Organization name already exists” even when the display name is also missing; it must not navigate to a heading for the existing organization. The malformed identifier “-invalid-organization” and a whitespace-only display name are rejected with the applicable field error.
claims.gap: Existing tests create a unique organization and verify success, but never submit the duplicate identifier with missing display name or the malformed identifier/whitespace display name, so those field errors and non-creation remain unestablished.

claims.quote: an existing member displays “Account is already a member”, and the unknown username `unknown-reviewer` displays “Account not found”
claims.gap: Existing add-member tests only cover the happy path and never exercise the duplicate or unknown-account failure messages or the unchanged single row.

claims.quote: A separately signed-in new member sees the organization identifier as complete visible text in Your organizations, while an ungranted private repository shows “Access denied”.
claims.gap: Add-member success tests verify membership and Your organizations but never open an ungranted private repository, so the rule that ordinary membership grants no private access is not established.

claims.quote: A private repository is accessible only to an organization Owner, a member with a direct repository role, or a direct member of a team that has a repository role; an ordinary organization Member has no default private-repository access.
claims.gap: Access-grant tests only verify the authorization list row; they never sign in a team member and open the private repository, so the resulting actual read access is unestablished.

claims.quote: The system blocks direct writes to a protected branch and applies the rule during subsequent PR merging.
claims.gap: The existing protection test creates a rule and sets a check but never attempts a direct write to the protected branch, so the rule's blocking effect is not established.

claims.quote: Only signed-in users with Write, Maintain, Admin, or organization Owner status may compare branches on the repository pull-request page; Read and Triage may view existing PRs but cannot enter the creation-comparison flow.
claims.gap: All comparison tests sign in as an Admin; a Read/Triage user is never shown to lack the creation-comparison entry.

claims.quote: if there is no difference, the branches are the same, a Draft or Open PR with the same source/target pair already exists, the title is empty or overlong, the user lacks permission, or submission fails, no record is created.
claims.gap: Existing creation tests never submit a second PR for the same source/target pair, so the duplicate-pair rejection and the 'no record is created' guarantee are not established.

claims.quote: Start a review displays the body and Pending review to its author immediately, retains the pending draft after reload, and does not make it public before review submission.
claims.gap: Existing inline-comment tests verify the pending comment in Files changed but never verify that it is absent from Conversation before review submission.

claims.quote: A user who is not the PR author and has Write, Maintain, or Admin may submit Comment, Approve, or Request changes on an Open PR; the author and Draft PRs cannot submit reviews.
claims.gap: Existing review tests only submit as a reviewer; no test checks that the author of a freshly created PR cannot use the review submission entry.
